category_feedback.specific_evidence: lesson_specific_materials lists 'Detective Dot and Tally puppets' as a required item. The rubric explicitly flags lessons that REQUIRE puppets as Level 2 because most Canadian K-3 classrooms do not have them on hand.
category_feedback.required_fix: Make the puppets explicitly OPTIONAL: replace with 'OPTIONAL: Detective Dot and Tally puppets, OR a stuffed animal, OR just point to the anchor poster / use a voice'. Add a no-materials path in differentiation (e.g., teacher voices Dot using the anchor poster on chart paper).

summary: Lesson 1 (Sort by One Rule) and worksheet 1 are well aligned on D1.1: rule-drift trap is real and grade-appropriate, the same-pile-different-rule re-sort drives the 'rule decides' concept, and the worksheet mirrors the three success criteria. Blocking issue: lesson_specific_materials REQUIRES Detective Dot and Tally puppets, which the rubric explicitly flags as Level 2 since most G1 classrooms do not have them. Mark the puppets optional and add a no-puppet path to reach pass.
